title: Customer Tool Card: Putting Upgrade Credit Toward a New Piece
content:
Upgrade credit standing on a registration under the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes goes toward a new piece on one till transaction and one merchandise line on it.

Credit is applied to a sale only after the registration carries the least the customer must spend worked out against the credit as it now stands. Until the registration carries that figure so worked out, credit is not applied to the sale.

## Whose action this is

Spending the credit is the customer's own. The tool `spend_upgrade_credit_c2e2bb76` is unlocked and handed over, and the customer themselves runs it. It adds a spend entry to the registration's running entries, lowers the credit still available by that amount, records the till transaction the credit went to, and moves the registration to part spent, or to fully spent where nothing is left. The customer sees that much taken off the new piece at the till and the rest of the credit, if any, still standing on their registration.

## Parameters

- `credit_reference` — the reference number of the trade-in registration the credit is being spent from, written on the customer's upgrade paperwork as TU- followed by six digits; it is read from the trade-in registration lookup.
- `credit_applied_amount` — how much credit is being put toward the new piece, in USD to 2 decimal places, a plain positive number with no currency symbol and no thousands separator; the tool stores it rounded to 2 decimal places by half-up arithmetic at the moment of the call and books it as a reduction of the credit.
- `redemption_receipt_number` — the till transaction the credit is being put toward, written as BR- followed by a four-digit year, a hyphen and six digits, for example BR-2025-118406; it is taken from the paperwork for the new sale.
- `redeemed_item_sku` — the merchandise line on that till transaction the credit is applied to, written as four letters, a hyphen and five digits, for example RING-40218; it is taken from the paperwork for the new sale.

## What comes back

A one-line confirmation naming the registration reference, the reference number of the spend entry just created, the credit put toward the new piece in USD to 2 decimal places, the credit still available afterwards in USD to 2 decimal places and the registration's standing after the spend. A string beginning "Error" means nothing was written; any other string means the credit has been applied to that till transaction.
